notes.title: Rush Rover has launched!
notes.content:
After nearly 1 year of Early Access, Rush Rover has finally released.

Due to our evaluation and player feedback during Early Access period, we've adjusted the price of base game after final release. Meanwhile,for everyone who bought the game during Early Access, your game has been upgraded to Deluxe Edition which include a brand new OST DLC.

Thank you all so much for supporting us, we couldn't finish the game without your help. We hope you could keep enjoying the game.

We would still keep updating this game and reacting to player feedback, please feel free to leave any comment as usual!

notes.title: Bug fixed and some change June 01
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27147928/6fe734827ac9743a7ae78d3cbaab2026e1e5f9b3.gif[/img]
1.Fixed some bugs.
2.Cancel booty.
3.Now the killing the enemies by level 3 Blink or Dashblade will reset its cooldown.
4.The Machinist will appears randomly in level 4 or below area.
====================================
Because of busy work recently,And some of the game mechanism changes, so the update progress is relatively slow.Sorry for update so lately.
1. The main weapons has the different appearance.
2. Dash item type will now replace the Booster slot directly and will not occupy the plugin slot. Such as Dash blade,Dash flame, Blink.
3. New item added:Comb rocket, Synopsy Ray, Bullet shield, Blink, Dash flame, Bolt module, Repair module, Interference module,the module part is still in the test,will be adjusted in the futrue.
4. Add a new currency resource that can be used to open a depot or wake up the craft bot.
5. New craft bots added.
Sync backup: allows players to set up a backup, when the player died, the backup will be sent to the battlefield to continue fighting.
Booty Chest: The end of each round of the game will be based on the kill BOSS reward different resources, stored in the Booty Chest for players to use at any time out.
Lottery Draw:a lottery machine, players can get random resources or items from it.
Junker:new dismantling system allow player disassemble the equipment to obtain resources, but also have the chance to get some other equipment or modules.
Cancel the craft bots retrieve, and now some craft robots will randomly appear in the map, they need player to find and wake up.
6. Now clear the area with Unscathed or blitz will get reward chest.
7. Added some new terrain area.
8. Now the airborne enemy will Fractional wave airborne reinforcements.
9. new achievements added.
